title: India News Hub Real News Integration Test
script: Namaskar, India News Hub mein aapka swagat hai. Aaj hum ek important news development ko simple aur clear language mein samjhenge.

scenes.heading: WHAT HAPPENED?
scenes.text: Yahan verified news facts aur important development explain kiya jayega.

scenes.heading: KEY DETAILS
scenes.text: Yahan story ke important verified details viewers ko clearly bataye jayenge.

scenes.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.text: Yahan news ka impact aur viewers ke liye iska meaning explain kiya jayega.

scenes.heading: WHAT NEXT?
scenes.text: Yahan available verified information ke basis par next developments explain kiye jayenge.
